w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! Aroha, James join you!

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
👥 Cesar sets out for Big-Eyes. "Meat's meat. Back with it or not at all."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
🤒 Wei is back on their feet — the fever ran its course.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
— DAY 114 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
📦 A care package drops from the sky with a little parachute. There's a note: "WE LOVE YOU! — your showbiz fans"

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Nusta telling Aroha about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.

📺 SYSTEM: "Tonight's exhibition is sponsored by the K'thari Expeditionary Veterans' Fund. Stand up straight. They're watching."

windowEndGuard: not-ready:Finish the current encounter before taking your seat.
auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/8/3), with 5 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 5 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Tāwhiri Ngata ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
